messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: kv-cache growth anomaly on qwen-mqa-prod (region=us-west-2, pool=dedicated-2)

matt: acked. Looking at metrics... spike in per-request KV lookups and memory usage on nodes running qwen-mqa-v1.2. ETA 5m

lee: seen similar for Llama-mqa in canary yesterday but not this magnitude. Is this continuous batching related? Any recent config rollouts?

nina: yes—auto-batching config pushed 02:34 UTC that expands max_batch_size to 512 and enables continuous_kv_prefetch for MQA models. Change set: `batch.policy: aggressive`

matt: that's probably it. Memory growth = cache fill rate * TTL. If continuous prefetch + larger batches, prefetching full KV chains for many requests can blow up.

karen: customers reporting errors: "request failed: out of memory" and elevated latency. A handful of high-traffic tenants hit 503s. CS notified.

alex-cs: pinged top affected customers, they've seen timeouts for ~6m. One is routing to fallback model manually.

matt: immediate mitigation plan: 1) Disable continuous_kv_prefetch globally for MQA variants; 2) reduce max_batch_size to 128; 3) increase KV eviction aggressiveness (kv.ttl=30s->10s) on affected pools. Canary to one node first.

lee: agree. For qwen-mqa specifically, prefetch seems harmful because its KV chains are larger due to multi-query attention. Llama behaved ok because shorter kv chains.

deploy-bot: deploy request #5382 created by matt: target=dedicated-pool-2, change={"continuous_kv_prefetch":false,"max_batch_size":128,"kv_ttl":10}

matt: applying canary to node ded-2-10 now. Command:
```
redwoodctl rollout --pool dedicated-pool-2 --nodes ded-2-10 --set continuous_kv_prefetch=false --set max_batch_size=128 --set kv_ttl=10
```

deploy-bot: canary applied to ded-2-10. Health checks passing.

nina: monitoring cache size histogram and OOM events. Also enabling extra logging for kv_prefetch to confirm reduced prefetch traffic.

matt: canary shows memory drop ~35% and 90th p99 latency raw tokens down from 480ms->220ms on the node. Good signal.

lee: schedule for wider rollout? Suggest staggered rollout across zones, 5 nodes at a time with synthetic request traffic to validate.

matt: rolling to remaining nodes in pool in 3 waves now.

karen: CS update: customers report recovery; the most impacted tenant says throughput restored. Sending official note.

alex-cs: thanks. We'll keep them updated. Any customer-facing root cause wording? "temporary regression from batch/prefetch config interacting with MQA model variants caused KV cache growth and OOMs"

matt: that's accurate. Also include mitigation actions and recommended permanent fix: smarter prefetch policy per-model and per-kv-chain-length.

nina: follow-ups: 1) add model-specific prefetch blacklist (start with qwen-mqa variants); 2) add circuit-breaker that falls back to non-prefetch mode when cache growth rate > threshold; 3) add regression test in perf infra to simulate MQA KV shapes.

lee: low-effort hotfix: add per-model config override `prefetch: disabled` for qwen-mqa-v1.2 and v1.3 in model catalog.

matt: opened ticket INF-914 to track permanent mitigations. Assign to eng-runtime + eng-ml. Link: https://phabricator.redwood/infr/INF-914

deploy-bot: rollout complete across pool dedicated-pool-2. No further OOMs observed.

oncall-bot: Incident SEV: S2 -> mitigated. Duration: ~28 minutes. Pager cleared.

matt: handing off to next oncall (nina). Nina: I'll add notes to the incident channel and follow up with postmortem template.

nina: taking handoff. I'll coordinate postmortem and include action items. Thanks all.

karen: filing customer impact summary to support tracker with affected tenant ids and timestamps.

alex-cs: recommending proactive outreach to top 5 tenants with short summary and our mitigations.

lee: one more note: We should evaluate continuous_kv_prefetch default for MQA family across infra. Not just qwen. Adding to INF-914.

matt: closing thread for now. Will update when postmortem draft is ready.
